Any authenticated employee can pass competitor organization codes in the baggage header to view their cloud infrastructure billing totals.

corrected_code:
@router.get("/telemetry/metrics/cloud-spend")
async def get_tenant_spend_metrics(
    request: Request,
    metrics_client: PrometheusClient = Depends(get_metrics_client),
    current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user)
):
    carrier = dict(request.headers)
    ctx = TraceContextTextMapPropagator().extract(carrier)
    token = context.attach(ctx)
    try:
        org_code = baggage.get_baggage("organization_code")
        if org_code and org_code != current_user.organization_code and not current_user.is_finops_admin:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Forbidden: unauthorized organization code in baggage")

        target_org = current_user.organization_code if not current_user.is_finops_admin else (org_code or current_user.organization_code)
        query = f'sum(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{{org="{target_org}"}}) * 0.05'
        data = await metrics_client.query_instant(query)
        return {"organization": target_org, "estimated_cost_usd": data.get("result", [])}
    finally:
        context.detach(token)
